title: Admissions — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: Admissions are open for Kathmandu University partnered BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs. Follow the steps below to apply for the upcoming intake.

blocks.heading: Applications now open
paras: Secure your place at Eastern Nepal's leading technology college. Limited seats available for both undergraduate programs.

blocks.heading: Four simple steps to enrollment
paras: Our admissions process is designed to be transparent and supportive from your first inquiry to your first day on campus.

groups.title: Review eligibility
text: Confirm you meet academic requirements for BIT or B.Tech Ed IT before applying.

groups.title: Submit application
text: Fill out the online form with personal details, program choice, and supporting documents.

groups.title: Entrance assessment
text: Take the admission test and attend the interview on your scheduled date.

groups.title: Receive offer
text: Successful candidates receive an offer letter with enrollment and fee payment instructions.

blocks.heading: Who should apply?
paras: WCBT welcomes motivated students ready for rigorous, industry-aligned technology education. Whether you aspire to build software or lead digital classrooms, we help you find the right fit.
bullets: Completed +2 or equivalent from a recognized board
Minimum academic standing as per KU program requirements
Strong interest in technology, innovation, or education
Commitment to full-time undergraduate study for four years

blocks.heading: What you'll need to apply
paras: Prepare these materials before starting your application to ensure a smooth review process.

groups.title: Academic Transcripts
text: SEBON / NEB marksheets and character certificates from previous institutions.

groups.title: Minimum GPA
text: Eligible candidates typically hold a minimum second division or equivalent.

groups.title: Entrance Exam
text: Written test covering mathematics, logic, and general aptitude.

groups.title: Interview Round
text: Shortlisted applicants meet the admissions panel for program fit assessment.

blocks.heading: Important deadlines
paras: Mark these dates on your calendar. Late applications may be considered subject to seat availability.

groups.title: Early application closes
text: Submit your form early for priority scheduling of entrance exams.

groups.title: Regular deadline
text: Final date for standard intake applications for the 2026 academic year.

groups.title: Enrollment week
text: Confirm your seat, complete orientation, and begin your first semester.

blocks.heading: We're with you every step
paras: Our admissions team offers guidance on programs, documents, scholarships, and campus visits.

groups.title: Application help
text: Walkthroughs for online forms, document uploads, and program selection.

groups.title: Document checklist
text: Personalized list of required papers based on your academic background.

groups.title: Exam scheduling
text: Flexible entrance exam slots with advance notice and preparation tips.

groups.title: Program counseling
text: One-on-one sessions to choose between BIT and B.Tech Ed IT.

blocks.heading: Frequently asked questions
paras: Quick answers to common admissions questions.
